messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "blood pressure can rise sharply if not started with alpha blocker"
set: ["blood pressure can rise sharply if not started with alpha blocker", "can lead to very low blood pressure", "risk in people with high blood pressure", "dangerously low blood pressure", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on a heart attack", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "high blood pressure usually has no symptoms", "untreated high blood pressure risks in pregnancy", "can cause blood clot around spinal cord if undergo spinal tap", "can cause blood clot around spinal cord if receive spinal anesthesia (epidural)", "many other drugs can interact with ondansetron", "switching without prescriber's instruction can significantly change blood levels", "stopping suddenly can increase risk of blood clot or stroke", "opioids generally not taken with tramadol", "other drugs can be dangerous when used with tramadol"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
